decisions.reason: The finned tube for air coolers builds directly on the firm's core heat exchange know-how and manufacturing investment. It had its own dedicated page through 2019, a visible commitment, and the missing archives for 2020-2021 can be read as temporary rather than as a failure, so management would persist with it.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes support the firm's announced efficiency and innovation direction and likely reflect R&D investment, possibly EU-funded. Having already dropped four other launches, management would want to justify its remaining 2018 commitments by keeping this core-adjacent product.
